name: video_speak
description: Make a character speak. Image+audio → talking head (Veed Fabric 1.0). Video+audio → lip sync (Lipsync 2.0). Omit `mode` for auto. Pass asset URLs or a creation `identifier` (from `audio_tts`, `images_generate`, `video_generate`). Then call `creations_show`.

videoUrl.description: Asset URL or a creation `identifier`. Required without `imageUrl`; mutually exclusive with it.

imageUrl.description: Asset URL or a creation `identifier`. Required without `videoUrl`; mutually exclusive with it.

mode.description: Omit for auto: image → veed-fabric-1.0, video → lipsync-2.0.

resolution.description: Only for veed modes; defaults to 720p.

voiceId.description: Voice ID from `audio_voices_list`; links the voice to the creation.

folderReference.description: Optional project/folder reference from `folders_list` to place results in. Omit for the default.
